name: shrink-report
description: Write a retail shrink report: how much stock was lost, where, split into theft, damage and waste, supplier and delivery error, and administrative error, with the evidence for each and a short action plan. Use when asked to write a shrink report, explain our stock loss, why is shrinkage up, analyse shrink by department, or prepare the loss report for the area manager. Produces a shrink summary as value and as a share of sales, a breakdown by department and cause, the top loss lines, a confidence note on each cause, and owned actions with a review date.
